title: Excel Finance Dashboard Kit
description: Build board-ready dashboards in minutes. P&L, cash flow and KPI templates with dynamic charts and a reusable design system.

faqs.q: Which Excel version do I need?
faqs.a: Excel 2016 or later, including Microsoft 365. A few formulas use dynamic arrays that work best on 365.
Yes. The colours and fonts are driven by the style guide tab, so you can match your company brand in a few clicks.

longDescription: Turn your month-end close from a scramble into a controlled, repeatable process. This Excel workbook tracks every task, who owns it, what it depends on, and where it stands, with a status dashboard that shows the whole close at a glance.

faqs.q: Is this tied to a specific ERP?
